# Automata Simulator

> A web-based visual editor and simulator for finite automata (DFA, NFA, PDA) and Turing Machines (TM).
> URL: https://automata.yuweiss.dev
> Source: https://github.com/YuvalWS/automata-simulator

## What This App Does

Automata Simulator lets users build automata diagrams interactively, simulate words step-by-step with visual highlighting, and save/load their work as JSON files. Works on desktop, tablet, and phone with full touch support.

Supported automaton types:
- **DFA** (Deterministic Finite Automaton) — exactly one transition per symbol per state, no epsilon transitions
- **NFA** (Nondeterministic Finite Automaton) — multiple transitions per symbol allowed, epsilon (ε) transitions allowed
- **PDA** (Pushdown Automaton) — adds a stack with pop/peek and push operations; supports final-state and empty-stack acceptance
- **TM** (Turing Machine) — read/write tape with head movement (L/S/R), configurable blank symbol; deterministic (DTM) and nondeterministic (NTM) variants; final-state and halt-on-accept acceptance modes; 1000-step cap with a `timeout` status

## JSON File Format

The app saves and loads automata as JSON files. You can generate these files programmatically and load them into the app.

### Save File Structure

```json
{
  "version": "1.4.0",
  "automaton": {
    "id": "<unique string>",
    "name": "<display name>",
    "type": "DFA" | "NFA" | "PDA" | "TM",
    "alphabet": ["a", "b"],
    "states": [ ... ],
    "transitions": [ ... ],
    "viewport": { "panX": 0, "panY": 0, "zoom": 1 },
    "acceptanceMode": "finalState" | "emptyStack" | "haltOnAccept",
    "pdaStackMode": "pop" | "peek",
    "tmMode": "deterministic" | "nondeterministic",
    "tmBlankSymbol": "_"
  }
}
```

### State Object

```json
{
  "id": "<unique string>",
  "name": "q0",
  "position": { "x": 100, "y": 200 },
  "isInitial": true,
  "isAccepting": false
}
```

### Transition Object

```json
{
  "id": "<unique string>",
  "sourceId": "<state id>",
  "targetId": "<state id>",
  "symbols": ["a", "b"],
  "pdaRules": [ { "inputSymbol": "a", "stackPop": "Z₀", "stackPush": ["A", "Z₀"] } ],
  "tmRules":  [ { "readSymbols": ["0", "1"], "writeSymbol": "X", "direction": "R" } ]
}
```

- `symbols` is used by DFA/NFA only.
- `pdaRules` is used by PDA only (mutually exclusive with `symbols`).
- `tmRules` is used by TM only (mutually exclusive with `symbols`).
  - `readSymbols` is a non-empty array of tape symbols; the rule fires if the head reads any of them. UI label: `0,1,Y → R`.
  - `writeSymbol` is optional. When omitted (or empty), the head cell is left unchanged (a textbook no-op write). UI label drops the write column: `Y → R`.
  - `direction` is `"L"`, `"R"`, or `"S"` (stay).

### Rules

- Exactly one state must have `isInitial: true`
- At least one state should have `isAccepting: true` for meaningful simulation
- DFA: each state must have at most one transition per symbol; epsilon (ε) is not allowed
- NFA: multiple transitions per symbol are allowed; epsilon transitions use the symbol `"ε"` (U+03B5)
- PDA: transitions use `pdaRules` (not `symbols`); stack-bottom marker is `"Z₀"`
- TM: transitions use `tmRules` (not `symbols`); the tape is initialized from the input word, head starts at index 0; rules match against the tape symbol under the head, **not** against the input word position. Multi-read rules fire when the head sees any symbol in `readSymbols`. Omit `writeSymbol` for a no-op write.
- DTM: at most one rule per `(state, readSym)` pair across all rules (a single rule's `readSymbols` array expands to one pair per symbol; two rules conflict if they share even one read symbol). Validator emits an error with a "Switch to NTM" suggestion.
- TM simulation hard-caps at 1000 steps; non-halting machines produce a `timeout` snapshot status
- The `alphabet` array should contain all symbols used in transitions (excluding ε); for TM the alphabet is informational only (the tape is unbounded)
- All `sourceId` and `targetId` values must reference existing state `id` values
- `viewport.zoom` must be a positive number
- Self-loops: set `sourceId` equal to `targetId`

## Example: DFA that accepts strings ending with "ab"

```json
{
  "version": "1.4.0",
  "automaton": {
    "id": "example-dfa",
    "name": "Ends with ab",
    "type": "DFA",
    "alphabet": ["a", "b"],
    "states": [
      { "id": "s0", "name": "q0", "position": { "x": 100, "y": 200 }, "isInitial": true, "isAccepting": false },
      { "id": "s1", "name": "q1", "position": { "x": 300, "y": 200 }, "isInitial": false, "isAccepting": false },
      { "id": "s2", "name": "q2", "position": { "x": 500, "y": 200 }, "isInitial": false, "isAccepting": true }
    ],
    "transitions": [
      { "id": "t0", "sourceId": "s0", "targetId": "s1", "symbols": ["a"] },
      { "id": "t1", "sourceId": "s0", "targetId": "s0", "symbols": ["b"] },
      { "id": "t2", "sourceId": "s1", "targetId": "s1", "symbols": ["a"] },
      { "id": "t3", "sourceId": "s1", "targetId": "s2", "symbols": ["b"] },
      { "id": "t4", "sourceId": "s2", "targetId": "s1", "symbols": ["a"] },
      { "id": "t5", "sourceId": "s2", "targetId": "s0", "symbols": ["b"] }
    ],
    "viewport": { "panX": 0, "panY": 0, "zoom": 1 }
  }
}
```

## Example: TM that flips a single 0 to 1

```json
{
  "version": "1.4.0",
  "automaton": {
    "id": "example-tm",
    "name": "Flip 0 to 1",
    "type": "TM",
    "alphabet": ["0", "1"],
    "states": [
      { "id": "s0", "name": "q0", "position": { "x": 100, "y": 200 }, "isInitial": true,  "isAccepting": false },
      { "id": "s1", "name": "q1", "position": { "x": 280, "y": 200 }, "isInitial": false, "isAccepting": false },
      { "id": "s2", "name": "qf", "position": { "x": 460, "y": 200 }, "isInitial": false, "isAccepting": true }
    ],
    "transitions": [
      { "id": "t0", "sourceId": "s0", "targetId": "s1", "symbols": [],
        "tmRules": [{ "readSymbols": ["0"], "writeSymbol": "1", "direction": "R" }] },
      { "id": "t1", "sourceId": "s1", "targetId": "s2", "symbols": [],
        "tmRules": [{ "readSymbols": ["_"], "direction": "S" }] }
    ],
    "viewport": { "panX": 0, "panY": 0, "zoom": 1 },
    "tmMode": "deterministic",
    "tmBlankSymbol": "_",
    "acceptanceMode": "finalState"
  }
}
```
